Name: Confeitaria do Bolhão
Tips: 08:45 breakfast option - galão + nata. Opens 07:00 on Saturdays. 2 min from hotel.

Name: Molete Bread & Breakfast
Tips: 08:45 breakfast option - local chain, fresh bread, bôla saloia (savoury Portuguese cake). 8 min walk.

Name: SO Coffee Roasters
Tips: 08:45 breakfast option - best specialty coffee in the city. Single-origin V60/Chemex, sourdough toast. 10 min walk.

Name: Matosinhos Beach
Tips: 09:30 - walk to Trindade Metro (8 min), Line A Red to Matosinhos-Sul, ~20-25 min, Z3 1.85 EUR/person. Door-to-sand ~35 min. Go before 10:30 for space. Wide Atlantic sand, lifeguarded, clean showers.

Name: Beach shacks on the promenade
Tips: 11:30 lunch - the r/porto pick. Plastic chairs, grilled fish of the day, Super Bock. No booking, just sit down. 5-10 min from the beach.

Name: Restaurante O Rafael
Tips: 11:30 lunch option - beloved local, kids love it, grilled fish done perfectly. Walk-in.

Name: Salta o Muro
Tips: 11:30 lunch option - no-frills staple, octopus rice, deep-fried sardines. Walk-in.

Name: O Gaveto
Tips: 11:30 lunch splurge - the definitive Porto seafood experience since 1984, Krug Ambassade 2025. Order from the fish display. Book by Fri Aug 14 for Sat Aug 22.

Name: Mercado - Food & Drinks
Tips: 11:30 lunch option - pick your fish at the market stalls, they prep it, the restaurant cooks it. Walk-in.

Name: Foz do Douro
Tips: 13:30 - Uber from Matosinhos ~8 EUR/10 min, or walk the seafront promenade through Parque da Cidade (~40 min, lovely). Where the Douro meets the Atlantic - gardens, the 1843 lighthouse, riverside cafés.

Name: Pão - Padaria Artesanal
Address: Mercado da Foz, Rua de Diu 365, Porto
Tips: Afternoon coffee inside Mercado da Foz - organic sourdough, canned fish toast.

Name: Tram 1 (Passeio Alegre)
Tips: 15:30 - start of the hidden-gems loop back. Oldest tram line in Europe (1872), open wooden carriages along the Douro. ~25 min to Massarelos, every 20-30 min. Buy on board, cash.

Name: Museu do Carro Eléctrico
Tips: 16:00 - get off at Massarelos, the museum is at the tram stop. 25 historic trams inside a 1915 power plant - 24 EUR for our four (both girls fit the 6-25 band). Sat 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:30, allow 45 min. Ticket includes one free tram/metro/bus ride within 4 hrs - save it for the hop home.

Name: Jardim do Palácio de Cristal
Address: Rua Dom Manuel II, Massarelos, Porto
Tips: 17:00 - 10 min uphill from the Tram Museum or one more stop on Tram 1. Daily 08:00-21:00 in summer. Free-roaming peacocks, the best free thing in Porto with kids. Walk to the western belvederes for the Douro views most tourists miss.

Name: Museu Romântico da Quinta da Macieirinha
Tips: 18:00 optional, 30 min. Adjacent to the Crystal Palace gardens. King Carlos Alberto of Sardinia died here in exile in 1849. Recreated mid-19th-century bourgeois rooms, almost no tourists.

Name: Cedofeita
Tips: 18:30 - 15-20 min walk back to the hotel through Porto's bohemian arts district.

Name: Cortiço & Netos
Address: Top of Rua das Flores, Porto
Tips: Souvenir stop on the walk home - authentic antique and reproduction azulejo tiles, the real thing, not tourist ceramics.

Name: Serralves Museum + Park
Address: Rua Dom João de Castro 210, 4150-417 Porto
Tips: ALTERNATIVE AFTERNOON if you skip the hidden-gems loop. Álvaro Siza modernist building plus an 18-hectare park with farm animals, treetop walkway, rose garden. Uber from Foz ~6 EUR, 10 min.

Name: Rua Miguel Bombarda Arts District
Tips: ALTERNATIVE AFTERNOON - Porto's bohemian gallery quarter, 20+ galleries, the 130 sq m Don Quixote mural, independent shops. Uber to Cedofeita ~7 EUR.

Name: Casa da Música
Tips: ALTERNATIVE AFTERNOON - Rem Koolhaas concert hall, striking exterior, guided tour at 16:00. Uber from Foz ~8 EUR, 12 min.

Name: The Yeatman Bar
Address: Rua do Choupelo 88, 4400-088 Vila Nova de Gaia
Tips: 18:30 pre-dinner drinks - terrace overlooking all of Porto, wine flights. Cross Dom Luís I Bridge then 5 min uphill.

Name: Bar Clássico
Address: Near Rua de Santo Ildefonso, Porto
Tips: 18:30 pre-dinner drinks option - old-school Portuguese bar, cheap and authentic, near the hotel.

Name: Loca
Tips: 20:00 farewell dinner, top pick. Porto's most talked-about table 2025-26. BOOK TODAY - the 2-3 week window for Sat Aug 22 is already tight. If Option B (Douro), shift the table to 20:30-21:00.

Name: Escama
Tips: 20:00 farewell dinner runner-up. The turbot with hazelnut vinaigrette is legendary. Book by Fri Aug 14.

Name: Cobre
Tips: 20:00 farewell dinner option on the Gaia side, bridge views from the terrace. Book by Fri Aug 14.

Name: Cais da Ribeira
Tips: 22:00 last night - walk back through the illuminated waterfront one final time. Pack tonight, Sunday starts at 05:45.
